eyebrow: The published Google SRE book definition
code:
toil is work that is:
  manual        -> a human does it by hand
  repetitive     -> recurs, not a one-off
  automatable    -> a machine could do it instead
  tactical       -> reactive, interrupt-driven
  devoid of enduring value  -> no lasting improvement
  scales linearly with service/traffic growth
caption: Postmortems and alerting design aren't toil — they leave the system better.

code:
10 services  ->  X hours of toil/week
200 services ->  20X hours of toil/week   (linear)

headcount    ->  grows SUB-linearly at best
                 (hiring is slow and expensive)

# either automate the toil away,
# or SREs spend less time preventing the next outage
caption: Toil grows with scale; headcount never does, at least not at the same rate.
